docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The Pañcadaśī, the fourteenth-century manual of Advaita Vedānta ascribed to Vidyāraṇya and Bhāratītīrtha, with the Sanskrit text and Nandalal Dhole’s English translation (Calcutta, 1899). Listed in the catalogue of the Rare Book Society of India.

From Internet Archive · Public domain in India

Scanned from a copy in the University of California Libraries; hosted by the Internet Archive. Item: A hand-book of Hindu pantheism. The Panchadasi of Sreemut Vidyaranya Swami · Madhava, d. 1386, Society for the resuscitation of Indian literature, Dhole, Nandalal, 1840?-1887, Bharatitirtha · 1899-1900, 364 scanned pages. Published 1899; Nandalal Dhole died 1887; Vidyāraṇya and Bhāratītīrtha are medieval; public domain in India.

This book is not stored in this library: its pages are shown from the Internet Archive when they are opened, in this library's own viewer, and each chapter ends with this credit. The text of each page is the machine-read (OCR) text of the scan, lightly cleaned; the scan of every page is one button away. The item on the Internet Archive (opened only if you click it).
